resources.string: Syncs the watch on its own, so sleep and activity arrive without opening the app. The watch has to be in range, and Android decides the exact moment, so a run can be a little late. Off means the watch is only synced when you ask.
Health Connect background access is off. A sync that runs while OpenWatch is closed still saves the watch\'s data. Body energy and the history charts catch up only when you open the app.
Android asks for these separately from Health Connect. Without them a watch cannot be found, and background syncs stop quietly.
Copies what your watch recorded into OpenWatch. Nothing is sent to the internet.
Pairing a watch lets OpenWatch copy what it recorded — sleep stages, resting heart rate, stress and Body Battery — without sending anything to the internet.
No watches found yet. Make sure your watch is awake and close to your phone.
Paired, but this watch uses a connection OpenWatch does not support yet, so it cannot sync.
Android did not link the watch to OpenWatch, so it was not added. OpenWatch needs this link to record workouts that another app starts on the watch. Tap Pair again and allow the request.
Paired, but Android access was not granted. Syncing works while OpenWatch is open.
The watch is busy. Try again in a moment.
OpenWatch will unpair the watch and forget which files it has already copied, so a future pairing starts fresh. Data already saved to Health Connect is kept.
Also delete the stress, Body Battery and score history that only this phone holds
Broadcast heart rate, speed, cadence or power to record it live during an activity. Turn on broadcasting on the device first.
No broadcast sensors found. Turn on broadcasting on the device, then try again.
The watch stopped answering part-way. What arrived was saved; sync again to continue.
The watch could not be synced. Try again.
Health Connect refused a write for want of permission. Allow OpenWatch to write this data in Health Connect, then sync again.
Allow OpenWatch to find and connect to nearby devices, then sync again.
The device did not answer. Keep it close, with Bluetooth on, and try again.
Health Connect asked OpenWatch to slow down. What arrived was saved; the next sync goes on from there.
Some records could not be saved to Health Connect. The next sync tries them again.
Workout calories not estimated: add your weight in Body profile or record one in Health Connect.
Walking calories not estimated: add your weight in Body profile or record one in Health Connect.
Walking calories not estimated: add your weight in Body profile, or allow OpenWatch to read your weight in Health Connect.
Steps not written: allow OpenWatch to write steps in Health Connect, then sync again.
Walking calories not written: allow OpenWatch to write active calories and read workouts in Health Connect to estimate them from the next sync on.
Heart rate variability not written: allow OpenWatch to write it in Health Connect, then sync again.
Breathing rate not written: allow OpenWatch to write it in Health Connect, then sync again.
Blood oxygen not written: allow OpenWatch to write it in Health Connect, then sync again.
Skin temperature not written: allow OpenWatch to write it in Health Connect, then sync again.
Resting heart rate not written: allow OpenWatch to read and write resting heart rate in Health Connect to estimate it from the next sync on.
Workouts not written: allow OpenWatch to write workouts, routes and distance in Health Connect, then sync again.
Not saved to Health Connect, for want of permission: %1$s. Allow them, and the next sync saves what the watch sends from then on.
Sensors and meters that pair with the phone itself. What they measure goes to Health Connect.
Android asks for this separately from Health Connect. Without it a device cannot be found or read.
Nothing found yet. Wake the device up and keep it close to your phone.
Pairing was not completed. Accept Android\'s pairing request to finish.
Could not reach the device. Wake it up and keep it close, then try again.
Allow OpenWatch in Android\'s dialog: it is how the phone hears the device when it has a reading.
